# A peat shambler: a lumpy peat mound (moss on its top faces) with a head, two dragging arms,
# two twigs and glowing eyes; 0.9 x 0.8 x 1.15 m.
# Generated by make_models.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Peat --base-color 0.5608 0.3020 0.3412 --no-slot
material new Moss --base-color 0.3882 0.6706 0.2471 --no-slot
material new Twig --base-color 0.2392 0.1608 0.2118 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 1.0000 0.3216 0.4667 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 0.3216 0.4667
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.42 --location 0.0000 0.0200 0.4000
scale 1.0 0.9 1.12
apply --scale
material assign Peat
apply --location
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.050 --seed 5
select face where "pos.z < 0.12"
delete only-faces
mode object
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.6"
material assign Moss
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Head --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.21 --location 0.0000 -0.1700 0.8000
scale 1.1 1 0.9
apply --scale
material assign Peat
apply --location
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.025 --seed 6
mode object
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.6"
material assign Moss
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name ArmL --vertices 6 --radius 0.09 --depth 0.4815 --location 0.3900 -0.1450 0.4100 --rotation 25.81 165.26 0
apply --rotation
material assign Peat
add mesh cylinder --name ArmR --vertices 6 --radius 0.09 --depth 0.4526 --location -0.3800 -0.1550 0.4300 --rotation 31.02 -166.76 0
apply --rotation
material assign Peat
add mesh cone --name TwigA --vertices 4 --radius1 0.04 --radius2 0 --depth 0.3306 --location 0.1400 -0.0850 1.0700 --rotation -12.22 21.80 0
apply --rotation
material assign Twig
add mesh cone --name TwigB --vertices 4 --radius1 0.04 --radius2 0 --depth 0.3002 --location -0.1750 -0.0500 1.0400 --rotation -19.46 -32.01 0
apply --rotation
material assign Twig
add mesh cube --name EyeL --size 1 --location 0.0850 -0.3700 0.8200
scale 0.07 0.04 0.06
apply --scale
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name EyeR --size 1 --location -0.0850 -0.3700 0.8200
scale 0.07 0.04 0.06
apply --scale
material assign Eye
select Body Head ArmL ArmR TwigA TwigB EyeL EyeR
active Body
join
select all
shade flat
export shambler.glb
